rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"The change stops TypeCollector from indexing DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] (and hard-casting the result to PropertyDeclarationSyntax) when it builds the MemberNeedsKey and BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull diagnostics. It uses FirstOrDefault and a safe cast instead, so members that exist only in metadata get a null location. It also wraps the analyzer's report callback so a diagnostic is reported only when its location is a syntax tree of the compilation being analyzed. Three new tests compile a generic struct or record struct into a metadata-only assembly, use a closed instance of it as a member, and check that the analyzers and generator report nothing and that the resolver is generated.","why":"A closed generic struct or record struct from a referenced assembly has no syntax references.
